name: diagnostic_minigpt_attention_f32
description: Preregistered MiniGPT FP32 C=768 projection with eight heads, sequence-axis Softmax, and LayerNorm.
reference:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F


def run(input, weight):
    sequence, channels = input.shape
    heads = 8
    projected = torch.mm(input, weight)
    head_channels = projected.transpose(0, 1).reshape(heads, channels // heads, sequence)
    probabilities = F.softmax(head_channels, dim=-1)
    rows = probabilities.reshape(channels, sequence).transpose(0, 1).contiguous()
    return F.layer_norm(rows, (channels,))
